decisive_spans.text: A 23-year-old man presented with a 1-year history of a gradually enlarging mass on the anterior aspect of his right wrist, along the radial edge

response.rationale: Giant Cell Tumor of Tendon Sheath is a common cause of a gradually enlarging mass on the wrist with median nerve compression, which aligns with the patient's presentation. Schwannoma is also supported by median nerve compression but is less specific to the mass characteristics.
